The plot is a line chart illustrating the training loss over the number of iterations for five different models or configurations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", spans from 0 to 140,000 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Each line represents a different model or variant: "Vanilla" (purple, solid line with no markers), "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue, solid line with no markers), "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange, solid line with no markers), "SepLLM (n=64, H)" (green, solid line with no markers), and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (red, solid line with no markers), along with "SepLLM (n=128)" (dark blue, solid line with no markers). All lines start near a loss value of 3.4 at iteration 0 and decrease sharply in the initial phase, then gradually flatten as iterations increase. The "Vanilla" model (purple) shows the lowest loss throughout, ending near 2.5 at 140,000 iterations. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue) consistently has the highest loss, ending near 2.62. The other SepLLM variants (orange, green, red, dark blue) show intermediate losses, with the "SepLLM (n=128)" (dark blue) ending near 2.52 and the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (red) ending near 2.51. All lines exhibit some noise or fluctuation, particularly in the early iterations, indicated by slight vertical spread around the main trend.
